protocol: A12 frozen development acceptance manifest for joint RAW denoising quality

scope.purpose: Freeze existing development examples and report noise, detail, dark-region and motion evidence separately before selecting a candidate.
scope.historical_baseline_evidence: Read existing metrics with original domains, dates, masks and sample identities; do not present them as newly executed experiments.
scope.new_cpu_measurements: Read existing prediction caches and original RAW; recompute explicitly named ROI diagnostics without running model inference.
scope.sampling_policy: Keep the recorded source frame indices; do not concatenate sparse clips into an apparently continuous video.

metric_protocol.prediction_storage: float16 normalized packed Bayer; cast to float32 before arithmetic and restore native DN using the matching per-channel black levels
metric_protocol.roi_coordinate_system: raw sensor pixels, half-open [x0, y0, x1, y1]; convert to packed Bayer coordinates consistently
metric_protocol.existing_roi_status: Fixed historical panel crops are heuristic regions, not semantic segmentation or clean-motion truth.
metric_protocol.static_mask: Use opposite-parity reference, existing reference.valid_region, source-frame motion rejection and unsaturated input; report valid population and fraction for every ROI.
metric_protocol.neighborhood_metrics: Use only valid neighborhoods for high-pass and signed gradient errors; do not let excluded motion or saturated pixels leak through a convolution boundary.

static_metrics.name: signed_gradient_error_dn
static_metrics.note: Compare signed horizontal and vertical differences, not only gradient magnitudes.

static_metrics.name: highpass_reference_ratio
static_metrics.note: A ratio near one is not sufficient evidence of correct texture or edge phase.

static_metrics.name: flat_residual_sigma_dn
static_metrics.note: Flat-region noise metric must accompany structure errors; smoothing alone can reduce it.

static_metrics.name: endpoint_clip_fraction
static_metrics.note: Report lower and upper endpoints separately; legal RAW after clipping is not a quality pass.

dynamic_metrics.name: input_relative_highpass_ratio
dynamic_metrics.note: Not interchangeable with static output/reference HF ratio.

metric_protocol.aggregation: Report each sensor, sequence, parity, ROI and channel before aggregate summaries; a pooled average must not hide a known failing domain.

acceptance_proposal.comparison: same frames, masks, reference domain and frozen ISP as A3 baseline
acceptance_proposal.static_rule: Joint no-regression in residual noise, reference structure errors, bias and clipping; any claimed gain must be reported with its trade-offs.
acceptance_proposal.dynamic_rule: Require improved current-frame structure and ghosting with acceptable residual noise on fixed examples; no clean-target pass is possible for existing real dynamic streams.
acceptance_proposal.cross_sensor_rule: Every required sensor must satisfy its own joint requirements; improvement on another sensor does not compensate for a failure.
acceptance_proposal.tolerance_next_step: Define tolerances using reference uncertainty, repeatability, numerical storage precision and product acceptance before choosing a candidate.

required_additions.requirement: New scenes and captures separated from all A3-A11 development and candidate selection, covering all four sensors.
Obtain qualified paired or controlled dynamic targets; do not use motion temporal means or old-teacher outputs as clean truth.
Freeze small detail, dark flat, moving boundary, occlusion and disocclusion ROIs with frame indices; existing display crops alone are insufficient.
Evaluate longer genuinely consecutive intervals and temporal-window boundaries; raw files exist but additional candidate/baseline inference may be needed.
Add sc450ai dark/flat data and independently validate per-channel signal-dependent, correlated and quantization behavior.
